name: oversells
description: Online LaTeX editor for textbooks and teaching materials

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @oversells/server & npm run dev -w @oversells/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oversells/web && npm run build -w @oversells/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @oversells/shared && npm run test -w @oversells/server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @oversells/server && npm run test:e2e -w @oversells/web
